_comment: What today's build does with each frozen payload in this directory.
The payloads are immutable records; these expectations are the reviewed
reading of them. See README.md for the one legitimate reason to edit a
block (a column added to Entry after the payload was written) and for why
nothing may regenerate the payloads themselves.
Every column the entries table holds must be stated in every row: the test
denies both unknown and missing keys, so a new column cannot slip in
un-decided and an old one cannot quietly stop being checked.

golden.note: The shape a build declaring content_hash definition v1 puts on the wire. Note dur/dur_precision: the current packer SPLITS the duration's uncertainty into the pre-da-b8rs sibling key, because an old peer parses `dur` strictly and would reject the `PT1H30M±PT1M` form outright. So adopt_legacy_uncertainty is not legacy-only code — delete it and today's builds start dropping dur_uncertainty from every sync, which is exactly what this golden goes red on.

Byte-identical to the golden above but for the absent hash_version, because that is the only thing da-engu changed on the wire. A real pre-declaration payload, and the proof that check_hash_version refuses it rather than merging across an unknown content_hash definition. If this ever flips to `decodes`, someone has loosened the one gate standing between an undeclared peer and a silently wrong (content_hash, device_id) tiebreak.
